notes: The verse-initial And is the one added unit: ὅθεν carries no coordination, no participle-to-finite juncture is in question at that position, and no source token in this verse or a neighbouring one licenses it (rules 5, 86).
SBLGNT.ACT.28.13.v017 is selected to r01, which supplies περιελθόντες; made a circuit answers to it, so no token is stranded and rule 97 does not arise.
δευτεραῖοι → on the second day heads on second: the Greek is anarthrous with no article to take the supplied determiner, so rule 17's generic-noun clause is in force.
